# Municipal Ordinance No. 001, Series of 2013

**A Resolution Reclassifying the Agricultural/Residential Lot of Spouses Nestor and Marie Opucel to a Commercial Land (Gasoline Station) at Barangay Poctol, Pitogo, Quezon**

Resolution No. 008

## Summary

Reclassifies the agricultural/residential lot of Spouses [[Nestor Opucel]] and [[Marie Opucel]] to commercial land (gasoline station) at [[Barangay Poctol]], [[Municipality of Pitogo]]. The property is covered by TCT T-097373 with a total area of 1,274 square meters. Based on the Zoning Ordinance, the land is within the built-up area of Brgy. Poctol. Per RA 7160 Rule VII, Art. 38, the municipality may reclassify land after public hearing.

Absent: [[Dexter L. Sayat]], [[Kenneth Earl T. Budao]] (PPSK).

## Key Provisions

- **Land Reclassification:** Agricultural/residential lot reclassified to commercial (gasoline station)
- **Property Details:** TCT T-097373, total area of 1,274 sq. meters at Barangay Poctol
- **Owners:** Spouses Nestor and Marie Opucel
- **Zoning Basis:** Land is within the built-up area of Brgy. Poctol per the Zoning Ordinance
- **Legal Procedure:** Reclassification conducted after public hearing per RA 7160 Rule VII, Art. 38 (IRR)

- [[Sangguniang Bayan]]
- [[Municipality of Pitogo]]
